levels.title: Roll to the Bowl
levels.goalText: Help the berry roll all the way into Lory's bowl!
levels.teaches: plank: a tilted plank makes a ball roll downhill
levels.hintText: The berry falls off the shelf right there... put your plank under it, tilted toward my bowl, and it will keep on rolling!

levels.title: Boing! Over the Wall
levels.goalText: Bounce the berry over the wall and into the bowl!
levels.teaches: trampoline: launches a falling ball back up high
levels.hintText: See where the berry plops onto the floor? Put the trampoline right on that spot and it will bounce sky-high over the wall!

levels.title: Heavy Helper
levels.goalText: Drop the heavy marble to fling the berry up to the bell!
levels.teaches: seesaw + marble: a heavy drop on one end flings a light thing up
levels.hintText: The berry sits on one end of my seesaw. Hold the marble WAY up high over the other end and let it drop. Boing... DING!

levels.title: Windy Day
levels.goalText: Blow the beach ball off the shelf to ring the bell!
levels.teaches: fan: steady wind pushes light things like beach balls
levels.hintText: The beach ball is so light! Set the fan on the shelf behind it, blowing toward the bell. Whooooosh!

levels.title: Domino Parade
levels.goalText: Fill the gap so the dominoes push the berry off the table into the bowl!
levels.teaches: domino: dominoes topple in a chain and can push a berry
levels.hintText: Three dominoes are missing from my parade! Stand them in the gap, nice and close, so the last one can nudge the berry off the table.

levels.title: Berry Express
levels.goalText: Catch the berry on the belt and ride it over the wall into the bowl!
levels.teaches: conveyor: a moving belt carries things sideways
levels.hintText: Catch the falling berry on my moving belt, arrows pointing right — it will ride straight over that wall. All aboard the Berry Express!

levels.title: Bumper Boing
levels.goalText: Bounce the beach ball off the bumper to ring the high-up bell!
levels.teaches: bumper: super bouncy, bounces balls much higher than the floor does
levels.hintText: Watch where the ball lands, then put the bumper right on that spot. Bumpers are SO springy the ball will rocket up to the bell!

levels.title: Pop Goes Bloopy
levels.goalText: Steer Bloopy the balloon into the spiky pokers — POP!
levels.teaches: balloons float up, fans steer them, spikes pop them
levels.hintText: Bloopy only floats straight up and bonks the flat ceiling. Put your fan in his path blowing right, and he'll drift into the pokers!

levels.title: Funnel Fun
levels.goalText: Catch the flying berry in the bucket so it drops into the bowl!
levels.teaches: bucket: catches a flying ball and drops it straight down
levels.hintText: That berry flies off all wobbly! My bucket has a big wide mouth — catch the berry up high and it will drop straight down into the bowl.

levels.title: Jump the Big Wall
levels.goalText: Bounce the berry OVER the big wall, then slide it into the bowl!
levels.teaches: combo: trampoline to clear a wall + plank to land the catch
levels.hintText: Trampoline BEFORE the wall to jump it, tilted plank AFTER the wall to catch the landing and slide home. Ta-da!

levels.title: Beach Ball Bowling
levels.goalText: The fan can't push the berry... but it CAN push something that can!
levels.teaches: insight: wind cannot move a berry, but a wind-blown beach ball can
levels.hintText: My fan is too gentle to budge a berry — but beach balls LOVE wind! Set the ball on the shelf and bowl the berry right off the edge.

levels.title: Double Bubble Pop
levels.goalText: Blow BOTH balloons along the ceiling into the middle spikes!
levels.teaches: combo: two fans working from both sides at once
levels.hintText: Two balloons, one spiky spot in the middle! Point your fans toward each other and the balloons will slide along the ceiling till... POP-POP!

levels.title: The Long Way Home
levels.goalText: Carry the berry LEFT on the belt, then bounce it over the wall into the bowl!
levels.teaches: combo: choosing belt direction + bouncing over a wall, all leftward
levels.hintText: Everything goes LEFT today! Point the belt's arrows toward my bowl, and put the trampoline between the belt and the wall.

levels.title: The Great Berry Machine
levels.goalText: Build the whole chain: dominoes tap the berry, the trampoline bounces it, a plank slides it home!
levels.teaches: grand finale: marble starter + domino chain + trampoline + plank in one machine
levels.hintText: Follow the story! My marble tips the dominoes, the last one nudges the berry off the table, the trampoline bounces it sky-high, and your tilted plank slides it into the bowl. Fill the domino gap first!

notes: Levels 1-6 each teach exactly one part in the required order (plank, trampoline, seesaw+marble, fan, dominoes, conveyor) using almost-built contraptions with one obvious gap, gentle 8-15 degree slopes, and wide targets. Level 7 hands over the last solo toy (bumper) as a playful breather, and levels 8-9 introduce the two new fixtures — balloon-into-spikes popping and the bucket funnel — each still needing only a single tray part. Levels 10-13 combine two ideas at a time with rising spatial reasoning: an arc over a wall plus a landing ramp, the insight that fans move beach balls but not berries, twin fans converging from both sides, and a full right-to-left direction reversal. Level 14 is the four-part grand machine replaying the campaign's whole vocabulary (marble starter, domino gap, trampoline bounce, plank slide) in one chain reaction. Robustness was engineered throughout: backstop-wall funnels guarantee the trickiest trampoline catches (levels 2 and 13), bells with their generous 46-58px contact radius are reserved for the wildest launchers (seesaw fling, bumper rocket), a guard wall in Berry Express prevents self-solving without the belt, final drops into bowls are short and near-vertical, and every failed run visibly shows the child where the missing part belongs. Goal mix: 9 catch, 3 bell, 2 pop; all trajectories were re-derived from the stated physics (g about 970 px/s2, 110% trampoline return, 280px fan reach, berry y = surface top minus 17) with landing points kept near the center of every target.
